style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: he is in flight in frame one and never perches or hovers, the loft streaming past him every beat; the camera tracks alongside him to a new shot size each beat, reversing at 1.25, 3.85 and 6.90; his face never under a third of frame, beak visible
character: a huge grey northern owl, grey facial discs, yellow eyes, no ear tufts, beak clear
second_characters: A SWARM of mice in rust-red coats pouring out of the bins with his coins, ONE a wing from the lens every beat, two in the first second; all moving
props: ONE felt hat with a peacock feather on his head from the first frame; A SWARM of walnuts and coins in the cracks; tall cupboards along the loft; ONE old grey blanket and a cube of pale blank banknote packs under it, out of sight until 6.90
prop_continuity: the hat never leaves his head, the feather streaming back clear of his beak; the blanket and the cube exist only from 6.90
environment: a sunlit grain loft packed with bins, cracks and tall cupboards a wing away, boards raking the lens
light_events: white noon through the boards, a hard rim on his hat

audio.delivery: a level male chest voice around 130 Hz, 4 syllables per second, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: na-ko-PLE-ni-ya, kog-DA, za-BYL, ot-lo-ZHIL, I-na-che, ot-LO-zhen-ny, ras-HOD
audio.pacing: speech fills 0.00-1.25, 1.55-3.85 and 4.15-6.90, first word on frame one; after 6.90 no spoken word, only his deep hoot and his gek-gek laugh, wings and paper to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: his beak opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: his deep hoot at 6.90, his gek-gek laugh from 7.50, wings, coins

timeline.a: he tears along the loft and rips a cupboard open in passing, the bins streaming past, TWO mice crossing the lens
he slings the door shut behind him and swings the other way, the loft tearing past
he tears across frame low, throwing a second cupboard open on the wing, mice pouring across the lens
he drives straight across the lens a wing away, beak wide, a third cupboard banging open behind him
he nudges the hat brim with one talon in mid-flight, the loft tearing past the other way
a mouse slings a walnut across his path, he hooks it in passing and tears on, coins out of the cracks
he hurls the walnut at the lens and tears across frame after it, the cupboards streaming past
A SWARM of mice launches off the bins across the lens with his coins as he rakes past them
he snatches an old grey blanket away in a pass with a deep hoot, the blanket whipping across the lens
a cube of pale banknote packs stands where the blanket was, he crashes into it laughing, packs bursting across frame
he rolls across the cube on his back, packs bursting past the lens
he tumbles at the lens through the flying packs, laughing, the hat over one eye

must_appear: the hat with the peacock feather on his head in every beat; a cupboard thrown open in passing at 0.00, 1.55 and 2.80; the blanket snatched away at 6.90, the cube of packs standing by 7.50; he rolls on the packs to 10.00; every word spoken, the last by 6.90
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, a static camera, a still background, a still first frame, a held pose, a perched hero, a hovering hero, a hero stopped at a cupboard, digits or numbers on the packs, a hat blowing off, a feather across his beak, slow motion, a word not in the lines, a closed beak while speaking, anything touching him before 6.90, ear tufts, brown or tawny plumage, foreign accent
